cards.name: Event-maintained ordered-write prefix certificate
cards.problem: Avoid repeated all-prefix payload tests when translated AW order differs from virtual W progress; keep advance conditional on actual payload ownership.
cards.added_action: Maintain per-bank committedAW/W-retire counters and a prefix-qualified bit for each owned pending read, updated only by accepted AW/WLAST events. Use bit at source AR firstVALID; latch offer to handshake.
cards.information: Actual sourceID/bank, job/epoch, logicalsrc/dst span relation, accepted virtual/physical AW/WLAST; no instantWREADY certificate. Copy relation requires a declared paid producer interface if absent in AXI.
success_path_pseudocode: At accepted virtualAW/physicalAW append owned stable identity and increment exact epoch counter.
At accepted virtualWLAST update owned finished prefix, never on AW authorization alone.
Qualify read only if own dstAW permissions and exact length/offset relation match, and preceding physical write obligations have already received their actual data.
Before firstVALID reserve output ownership; keep header and certificate commitments stable through handshake; pay storage and port updates.
On fault/invalidation/identity ambiguity stop new grants and retain ownership until actual error/drain completes.
strong_controls: ordinary virtualWhead+matching preparedAW with existing W-selection counters
full-prefix scan only as diagnostic or expensive comparator, never solebaseline
cards.decisive_case: Would require same ordinary head/preparedAW information but a safe distinct grant or a complete reducedcost point.
cards.neighbor: Original aligned4KiB/twoDMA sequence where ordinary O(1) decision already matches.
cards.root_preliminary_reason: No new action relative to complete ordinary head+preparedAW/prefix control; event certificate is alternate implementation. Extra state cannot establish a lowercost claim against already O(1)control. No performance fixture authorized.

cards.name: Ordered physical-AW issue with advance virtual-AW permission preparation
cards.problem: Current incoming demux forbids accepting another bankAW while current W group remains open, so an unrelated destination permission cannot enter that bank yet.
cards.added_action: Replace current samebank W-opening constraint with paid stable AW acceptance queue and original-order W selection; allow bank-native WRITE permission processing ahead, but publish physicalAW only at the oldest successful committed ticket. Rdispatch retains Mode7 or full return reservation.
cards.placement: New private ingress architecture before accepted bank headers and before physicalAW firstVALID; never change a held incoming/outgoing AW or undo committed ownership.
cards.information: Original fullAXIID, immutable bank, full header stored in owned native queues, ordered ticket/reservation, actual permission/result retirement; no free metadata copied from oracle.
success_path_pseudocode: Reserve bounded ticket before first upstreamAW VALID/handshake obligation is accepted; save full header once in owned storage and enqueue bank/reference in global commit order.
Independently route queued AW to its bank FIFO with stable payload; normal permission check and existing onePTW/two-bank result owners remain.
Permit physicalAW firstVALID only for oldest unresolved ticket with actual success and exact header; hold until handshake, then advance commit pointer.
InputW is routed in original AW order using its independent Wcursor and actualWLAST; physical outputW follows actual outputAW order.
Retire shared queue record only after both orderedAW obligation and orderedW obligation no longer need that record; B identity/inflight tracking remains live until actual response.
For error/noPA result, retain ticket/owner; exact errorW/B sequencing and invalidation must be specified before any actual prototype or safety claim.
strong_controls: ordinary write-permission prepare then FIFO orderedissue
ordinary split AW-routing queue with W-selection FIFO and sequence reorderbuffer
generic shared immutable descriptor queue with independent ordered AW/W cursors and legal field recycling
perDMA queues and full return reservation
cards.decisive_case: Requires native earlydestinationpermission changes useful completion or provides a complete cheaper state point than these controls; a queuedAW ability alone does not prove novelty.
cards.neighbor: Samebank sequence or short bufferedW where original demux already opens before permission ends.

costs.new_state: bounded ticket bank/ref, two independent cursors/occupancy, held owner, fault/error retire and B ownership bookkeeping
costs.full_headers: existing native head may be reused only while provably owned; duplicate storage included when lifetime requires
costs.new_payload: zero proposal; all native W/dataFIFO remain paid
costs.ports: independent AW routing/control, Wbank selector and output order arbitration
costs.permission_context_capacity: no extraPTW; owned result/header capacity included
costs.ticket_example: At native8 totalAW heads, generic candidate ticket skeleton may hold bank1bit + AWdone/Wdone2bits perrecord (24bits), four3bit ring pointers12bits and occupancy4bits=40bits before held-offer and fault/B bookkeeping. This is a field subset only, not total area or a net saving. Existing AW header FIFO remains paid; no random access to unseen head is assumed.

cards.root_preliminary_reason: This is a positive architectural proposal with a changed ingress capability. No native useful-work/cost witness yet. Complete ordinary queue/preparation architectures may express it at equal or lowercost; verify specific complete control, do not infer published coverage from components or copying this proposal.
cards.contract_precision: Upstream firstVALID is an external commitment and cannot be retracted. The newblock reserves stable storage before accepting/propagating that held header into a bank; it does not assert control over when upstream originally raised VALID.
